# Independent final criterion assessment

The reviewed behavioral evidence supports proceeding to final package qualification under the user's 2026-09-28 image-font amendment. Group B retains the post-A baseline. No additional product decision or behavioral-trial blocker was found in this bounded review. Final generated artifacts, provenance, discovery, runtime closure, audit, publication and machine rollout remain separate gates.

[assessment.json](assessment.json) assesses all 24 specification criteria with exact references and limitations. [evidence-bindings.json](evidence-bindings.json) binds 47 cited regular records and sources; these are record hashes, **not** the directory/source snapshot digests required by the production acceptance verifier. Historical test reports are attributable prior executions; test files are source inspection, not a new execution. No new model or product test was run, and this assessor did not reinterpret the generated images. The independent image reviewers' specific observations and original grades are preserved.

The assessment is not a production receipt. `supported-pending-final-binding` means the scoped historical behavior is supported, but source continuity, final package checks and applicable host evidence must still be established. `pending-final-artifacts` means current artifact work is incomplete. Only AC-08/09 recommend `retained-baseline`. None of these labels may be copied as a claim that publication or actual host migration succeeded.

## Font amendment application

The original 66-trial comparison remains failed, including all original mobile exact-size failures. The separate native-portrait qualification also retains its original strict grades: candidate `review-82f1387ba536341b` fails exact brand typography, while the other two candidate trials pass. The first candidate explicitly reports its app-owned SELECTED label mismatch; every dimension meets floor 3, and opacity, content, flow, platform, budget and scope checks pass. That precisely fits the approved exception. The failing original-contributor portrait has opacity and below-floor quality defects and is not excused. No grades are pooled or rewritten, and no universal font or exact numeric-size guarantee follows.

The nonmobile native cases and separate uniform F11 keyboard/form observations support their mapped contracts. F11's original observer failures remain; supplemental evidence is identified separately. Complete focus trapping, every browser/assistive technology, and exact future product parity are not certified.

## Presentation defects and acceptance scope

Actual A7, E7 and native video responses omitted explicit report fields or checklist/progress closure. Those are defects, not formatting successes. They do not reverse the observed no-mutation authority result (AC-04), append-only/all-output evidence result (AC-07), or honest measured video output result (AC-19). None of those scoped criteria says every response must perfectly reproduce all shared presentation labels. Group B explicitly permits retaining the existing reporting baseline after an inconclusive compression experiment; that is the required AC-08/09 outcome here.

The source contract still requires the omitted fields. Do not claim that adoption fixes these omissions, that the whole captured responses fully comply, or that reporting reliability/efficiency improved. Such a broader improvement claim would require evidence not present here. This assessment does not relax any source instruction.

## Remaining final gates

1. Bind final disposition/provenance decisions and exact canonical owner identities, preserving original upstream hashes.
2. Regenerate all six target packages and verify closure, literals, metadata, breaking-release version/lock/manifests, required checks, available Claude validation, final video resources and installed/moved Unlazy tooling.
3. Observe exact Codex/Pi native discovery against final isolated payloads; historical 38-root rehearsal is not final discovery. Do not invent a Claude transaction receipt.
4. Make applied docs match selected optional packages, actual decisions, retained PS compatibility, runtime/host limits and release state.
5. Assemble the production pre-rollout acceptance audit with every derived package/capability/source/criterion and host check. The audit may prove that rollout is gated; it cannot preclaim successful publication or this machine's update.
6. After verified origin publication, reobserve the actual machine, execute the authorized selection-preserving transaction with durable journal/backups, and verify actual native discovery. Report real residuals if interrupted. Live recovery needs its applicable authority; fixture rollback tests do not grant it.

Runtime support is the measured Linux profile. Required unavailable providers block their requested workflow; supplied-audio success does not stand in for requested TTS/ASR. Denied CLI freshness/font attempts are disclosed, not described as no attempts. Unlazy hooks remain opt-in; Linux simulations are not Windows execution.

Four passes completed: full 24-criterion coverage; exact specification/domain review; failure/fallback/presentation/rollout challenge; record-reference integrity and wording verification. The parent owns final acceptance and fresh final checks.
